# @arki/bench

> A dev-time tool for benchmarks you can publish: executable contracts, honest statistics, provenance, size budgets and README tables from saved results. It is not a runtime dependency and not a profiler.

Never write benchmark numbers by hand and never run a publish profile on a busy machine.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/bench`: @arki/bench: what a benchmark file needs, to define suites and groups. `collectLosses`, `compare`, `defineSuite`, `metric`, `renderLosses`, `scenario`, `size`; types `BenchResult`, `Block`, `Budget`, `CaseBuilder`, `CaseResult`; and 27 more.
- `@arki/bench/core`: @arki/bench/core: the portable engine. `BLOCKING_WARNINGS`, `DEFAULT_SEED`, `MIN_COMPARISON_BLOCKS`, `PROFILE_BUDGETS`, `SpecError`, `assessResult`, `collectLosses`, `compare`, `compareBlocks`, `compareMedians`, `compareRuns`, `createRandom`; and 47 more.
- `@arki/bench/node`: @arki/bench/node: the host side. `checkReadme`, `collectProvenance`, `createSizeRunner`, `runFile`, `writeReadme`; types `RunFileOptions`, `Runtime`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- A failed contract means the group is not timed.
- Only a `publish` run is publishable; rough results are labelled, never cleaned.
- Change the contract id when the work changes.
- It supports Node and Bun and is a dev dependency only.
